address_cleartext_public: Public addresses need https://. Plain http is only allowed on your home network.
cert_body_private: The server at %1$s uses a certificate your phone doesn't trust, such as a self-signed one. Compare the fingerprint below with your server before you trust it.
cert_body_public: The server at %1$s uses a certificate your phone doesn't trust. For security, the app only allows this on your home network.
cert_hint: If the certificate changes later, the app will ask again.
cleartext_blocked: The connection to %1$s was blocked because it isn't encrypted. Use an https:// address.
connection_failed_body: None of this server's addresses responded as Mealie. Check the addresses and your network.
import_blocked_body: This site blocks automatic reading. Continue on Mealie's import page, where you can paste the recipe.
import_exists_body: “%1$s” was already imported from this link.
import_failed_body: We couldn't find a recipe on this page. You can try again, or continue on Mealie's import page.
import_partial: Some details are missing. Check the recipe before you cook.
import_reading: Reading the recipe from the page…
local_network_explain: To connect at home, the app needs permission to reach devices on your local network.
more_mealie_menu_hint: Everything else in Mealie: create, timeline, admin and more
more_oidc_hint: Opens your browser. Works with passkeys and Google
more_token: Sign in with an API token
more_token_hint: Paste a long-lived token from your Mealie profile
no_app_for_link: No app can open this link
oidc_unavailable: Browser sign-in isn't set up on this server
onboarding_footer: You can add a home network address and a remote address. The app switches between them automatically.
onboarding_subtitle: Connect to your Mealie server to get your recipes, meal plans and shopping lists on your phone.
page_error_body: This page didn't load. Check your connection and try again.
probe_cleartext: Blocked: plain http to a public address
probe_gate: Login page in front of Mealie. You'll sign in next
probe_untrusted_private: Certificate isn't trusted. You can review it
scale_fix_confirm_body: The app goes over every recipe on the server, adds an amount to ingredients saved as plain text and links units such as cups or grams, so Mealie can change them with the servings. Lines without one clear amount, such as ranges, are left as they are.
scale_fix_error: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
scale_fix_hint: Add amounts to ingredients saved as plain text, so changing the servings changes them too
scale_fix_nothing: All recipes are already set up for scaling
scan_failed: Couldn't scan the code. Try again or type the address.
scan_no_play_services: QR scanning needs Google Play services. Type the address instead.
scan_preparing: Getting the QR scanner ready. Try again in a moment.
server_remove_body: Remove %1$s from the app? You'll be signed out on this device.
settings_compress_hint: Up to 2048 px, so uploads are fast and fit server limits
settings_dynamic_color_hint: Use your phone's colours instead of Mealie orange
settings_import_categories_hint: Add the site's categories to the recipe
settings_import_tags_hint: Add the site's keywords to the recipe as tags
settings_raw_hint: Turns off the app's layout tweaks to Mealie
settings_timers_hint: Times like “bake for 25 minutes” become a button that sets a timer on your phone
share_no_url: No link found in the shared text
timer_choose_body: The recipe gives a range. Pick how long to set the timer for.
timer_no_clock: No clock app on this phone can set timers
token_body: Create a token in Mealie under Profile, then API Tokens, and paste it here.
update_failed_body: The update could not be installed
update_permission_body: To install updates, allow this app to install apps in your phone's settings.
update_ready_body: Tap to finish installing the update
widget_meals_desc: See what's planned for today and open the recipe in one tap
widget_no_server: Set up your Mealie server in the app
widget_shopping_desc: See what's left to buy and check items off right from your home screen
widget_sync_failed: Couldn't save. Tap to try again
